blocks.text: GENEVA, Switzerland — Developing countries should seize emerging opportunities from global trade system reforms and diversifying global supply chains, according to the World Trade Organization (WTO). WTO Director-General Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala said developing economies should identify and lobby for revisions to existing trade policies rather than complain about them. READ: PH backs careful recalibration of global trade rules—official “They have their criticisms. They believe that some of the trade rules are not working in their favor, and they would like to have space to grow, manufacture, create jobs, and industrialize, and they should,” Okonjo-Iweala said on Thursday (Geneva time).
